photography: Open the lockbox. The code is the year when construction of Nowa Huta began.
crossword:
You are next to the Ludowy Theatre. It is the oldest institutional theatre still operating in Nowa Huta. It opened in 1955.

Go to the café on the left side of the theatre. Tell the staff this password:

“Citizen’s Mission – Nowa Huta”

They will give you the next clue.
tracking:
Before smartphones and game consoles, children often played outside. One popular game was following signs to find the correct way.

Follow the chalk arrows on the ground. Each colour marks a different path. Be careful! Some paths may have false turns.
puzzles: Arrange the cards in chronological order. Read the marked characters from the oldest event to the newest.
